name: Dire Straits

whyMatters.en: British band formed in 1977. Mark Knopfler’s fingerstyle Telecaster and narrative lyrics define the early sound; Sultans of Swing (1978) put clean tone on late-1970s AOR radio beside louder hard rock.
whyMatters.zh: 英国乐队，1977 年成立。Mark Knopfler 的指弹 Telecaster 与叙事歌词构成早期声音；Sultans of Swing（1978）把干净音色送上 1970 年代末 AOR 电台，与更响的硬摇滚并列。

lyricQuotes: You get a shiver in the dark / It's raining in the park but meantime

shortBio.en: Newcastle four; Knopfler fingerstyle Telecaster; Sultans of Swing as the 1978 AOR landmark.
shortBio.zh: 纽卡斯尔四人组；Knopfler 指弹 Telecaster；Sultans of Swing 是 1978 年 AOR 地标。

body.en:
Dire Straits formed in 1977 in the Deptford/Newcastle circle. The debut album Dire Straits (1978, produced with Muff Winwood) put Knopfler’s pickless fingerstyle—Strat/Tele through clean Fender amps—against pub-rock storytelling. Sultans of Swing is the citation track: Dorian melody lines over Illsley/Withers pocket, without a fuzz wall.

Making Movies (1980) and Brothers in Arms (1985, digital recording; Sting guest vocal on Money for Nothing) scaled the band to MTV and stadium audiences. Core craft remains guitar tone and narrative verse more than riff density.
body.zh:
Dire Straits 于 1977 年在 Deptford/纽卡斯尔圈子组建。首张专辑 Dire Straits（1978，Muff Winwood 参与制作）把 Knopfler 的无拨指弹——Strat/Tele 进干净 Fender 箱头——对准 pub-rock 叙事。Sultans of Swing 是引用曲：Dorian 旋律线压在 Illsley/Withers 口袋拍上，没有 fuzz 墙。

Making Movies（1980）与 Brothers in Arms（1985，数码录音；Sting 客串 Money for Nothing）把乐队扩到 MTV 与体育场听众。核心工艺仍是吉他音色与叙事主歌，多于 riff 密度。

note.en: Fingerstyle lead over a shuffle pocket; clean Telecaster on late-1970s AOR.
note.zh: 指弹主音压 shuffle 口袋拍；干净 Telecaster 落在 1970 年代末 AOR。

note.en: National resonator intro; ballad dynamics before Brothers in Arms scale.
note.zh: National 共鸣琴 intro；Brothers in Arms 扩容前的谣曲动态。

note.en: Gibson Les Paul and gated synth texture; MTV-era radio hit.
note.zh: Gibson Les Paul 与门限 synth 质感；MTV 期电台热单。

title.zh: 指弹与硬摇滚音量并列

body.en:
Knopfler plays without a pick: thumb and fingers articulate bass and melody on one guitar. Early Dire Straits sat next to pub rock and AOR, not NWOBHM.

Sultans of Swing (1978) is the key track—clean amp, story lyric, lead lines that read like horn phrases.

Brothers in Arms later adds digital polish; identity stays guitar craft over distortion density.
body.zh:
Knopfler 不用拨片：拇指与手指在一把琴上分出低音与旋律。早期 Dire Straits 靠 pub rock 与 AOR，不靠 NWOBHM。

Sultans of Swing（1978）是关键曲——干净箱头、故事歌词、像号声乐句的主音线。

后期 Brothers in Arms 加数码抛光；身份仍是吉他工艺，多于失真密度。

title.zh: Knopfler 兄弟到体育场编制

body.en:
Debut lineup: Mark and David Knopfler, Illsley, Withers. David left in 1980; Alan Clark’s keyboards expanded Making Movies.

The Brothers in Arms era added studio and tour players; Mark remained sole lead voice and primary writer.

Scale change came through production and television, not an ideology split.
body.zh:
首张阵容：Mark 与 David Knopfler、Illsley、Withers。David 于 1980 年离队；Alan Clark 的键盘扩了 Making Movies。

Brothers in Arms 期加入录音室与巡演乐手；Mark 仍是唯一主唱与主写。

体量变化来自制作与电视，而非意识形态分裂。

body.en:
Cite path: country/blues fingerstyle into UK pub rock, then US FM. Money for Nothing reached MTV hard-rock adjacent radio while keeping narrative verse.

Later stadium and alternative guitarists with clean delay tones often name Knopfler as a tone reference more than a riff school.
body.zh:
引用路径：country/blues 指弹进英国 pub rock，再到美国 FM。Money for Nothing 进入 MTV 邻域硬摇滚电台，同时保留叙事主歌。

后期体育场与 alternative 吉他手（干净延时音色）常点名 Knopfler 作音色参照，多于 riff 学派。

interviewQuotes.text: Sultans was just a song about a band in a pub. The radio made it something else.
